items.title: OpenAI and journalism
items.summary: We support journalism, partner with news organizations, and believe The New York Times lawsuit is without merit.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI发表声明称其支持新闻业，积极与新闻组织开展合作，并认为《纽约时报》提起的诉讼缺乏法律依据。

aiReview.reasonZh: 文章简述了OpenAI对新闻机构合作及相关法律诉讼的立场，属于行业动态。
